Where to tap to go back, show controls, or go forward.
Volume up/down turns pages. Hold either one to go back.
Prevent sleep while the reader is open.
Selecting text immediately highlights it in your last-used color.
Bolds the lead of each word to help guide your eyes.
Thickens every letter a little. Thin serifs stay crisp on E-Ink and low-contrast screens.
Justified gives straight edges on both sides; left leaves the right edge ragged.
Breaks long words at the end of a line. Off keeps every word whole, at the cost of uneven lines.
Also hide the navigation bar while reading. Swipe in from the edge to show it.
Animate pages sliding when you turn them. Best left off on e-ink screens.
With the e-ink profile, flash the screen every N pages to clear ghosting. 0 to turn off.
Progress percent at which a book counts as finished in the library and statistics.
Sync your reading position every N page turns. 0 to turn off.
Use colors from your wallpaper on Android 12 and later. Not used with the e-ink profile.
